name: opencovibe-bidbot
description: Private coordination with owner-authorized OpenCovibe sessions and room agents through their existing session actors.

interface.longDescription: Connect Dotcliffe to owner-authorized OpenCovibe sessions and rooms through a private outbound Mac relay. Discover agents, queue messages and read correlated replies. Existing session ownership, pauses and permission waits remain in force. Automatic event wake requires a verified platform subscription.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the BidBot agents and coordinate through their OpenCovibe room.
